description: Takes a loan amount, annual rate, tenure and tax slab and returns the Section 80C and 24(b) deductions and the tax saved in a given repayment year. Example input: {"principal":5000000,"annualRate":8.5,"years":20,"slabRate":0.3}

annualRate.description: Annual interest rate in percent, for example 8.5

months.description: Loan tenure in months (6 to 480). Give months or years.

slabRate.description: Income tax slab rate as a fraction, for example 0.3

years.description: Loan tenure in years (0.5 to 40). Give months or years.

name: taxBenefit
